meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 把消息渠道接到 agent 群组上:选择会话隔离方式、会话模式与触发方式,注册渠道,并列出已接、已配置未接和未配置的渠道。
howto.when: 添加渠道之后、初始设置过程中,或想单独重新配置现有接线时。

say.text: 看看现在哪些渠道已经接好、哪些还没接
say.note: 列出已接、已配置未接、未配置渠道及特权用户

say.text: 把这个新的 Telegram 群接到我现有的 agent 群组上
say.note: 走 register 流程创建接线

say.text: 把 Slack 渠道改成独立 agent,单独一个文件夹
say.note: 新建 agent 群组与文件夹

howto.what_en: Wires messaging channels to agent groups: picks isolation level, session mode and engagement, registers the channel, and lists wired, configured-but-unwired and unconfigured channels.
howto.when_en: Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure an existing wiring.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are already wired and which aren't
say_en.note: Lists wired, unwired and unconfigured channels

say_en.text: Wire this new Telegram group to my existing agent group
say_en.note: Runs register to create the wiring row

say_en.text: Move the Slack channel to a separate agent with its own folder
say_en.note: Creates a new agent group and folder
